ai_playback_boundary_note: Conversational or AI playback is not silently treated as a complete official answer when qualifiers, exceptions, or help routing matter.
authority_boundary_note: Browser-integrated page-audio playback remains subordinate to the current official page and the named official help lane the office actually stands behind.
background_playback_note: The route assumes some listeners may continue playback while not looking at the screen, so source-page recovery and help routing stay easy to recover without guesswork.
browser_page_audio_surface_label: Example browser-integrated read-aloud and page-audio posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official voter-information pages so browser-integrated read aloud, listen-to-page, reader-view narration, and AI page-audio playback remain subordinate to the current official page plus the named help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow official briefing.
high_risk_topic_routing_note: When narration ambiguity affects deadline, location, eligibility, ID, cure, or rights-sensitive questions, the route moves the voter back to the visible current official help lane instead of pretending page audio settled the matter.
privacy_minimization_note: The service preserves route IDs, reviewed narration-context labels, policy notes, and timestamps rather than individualized listening histories or generated audio artifacts.

reviewed_narration_contexts.context_note: Reviewed ordinary browser read-aloud posture for the already-open official page.
Reviewed page narration when the browser first simplified the page into a reader-style view.
Reviewed whether conversational or AI playback could sound more authoritative or more complete than the current official page.
Reviewed whether the answer remained recoverable when playback could continue while the user looked away, switched tabs, or locked the screen.

serial_audio_boundary_note: When a route is consumed as serial audio, the page keeps route identity, scope, qualifiers, and the next official help step close enough together that narration does not quietly detach them from one another.
source_page_recovery_note: The page preserves enough source-page identity and official help routing that the voter can recover the visible official page and current help lane after or during audio playback.
